sources.label: Personal patch bundle for Morphe
sources.author: dieroboter
patch_list: Flips the AppLovin terms-and-privacy flow in LiteRobTopActivity.setupGAM from enabled to disabled, so the first-launch ad consent dialog never appears.
Makes AppMetrica.activateReporter a no-op, so the AppMetrica reporter the Yandex mediation glue sets up is never activated and its events are dropped.

No-ops the native bridge methods that show banner and interstitial ads (LiteRobTopActivity._enableBanner / _showInterstitial) and makes _hasCachedInterstitial report false. Rewarded video ads are left working.
Removes the ad identifier permissions (AD_ID and the Ad Services permissions: ad ID, attribution and topics) from the manifest.
